recommendation: Keep the commit as a bounded source fix for FHIR-38834. Broader translation/designation guidance should remain with the open FHIR-51614 work-group discussion.
issue_request: FHIR-38834 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core CodeSystem and asked that the CodeSystem.concept.designation comment use "primary designation" instead of "primary code" to avoid implying that designations may carry alternate concept codes.
initial_application: Commit 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98 had already changed the formal CodeSystem.concept.designation StructureDefinition comment to "primary designation", but it did not update the active CodeSystem narrative text.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini. The same wording family is connected to older FHIR-18575/FHIR-18637 and a later open FHIR-51614 broader guidance request; FHIR-51614 remains unresolved and was not decided.
reconciliation: Changed source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml from "primary code/designation" to "primary designation" so the built CodeSystem page no longer preserves the ambiguity FHIR-38834 was accepted to remove.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml: changed the active CodeSystem designations narrative from "primary code/designation" to "primary designation".

related_jiras.note: Older Published ValueSet/designation issue requested the same "primary designation" wording and explains the wording family's history.
CodeSystem duplicate of FHIR-18575, confirming the same narrative wording had been identified in CodeSystem.
Later Triaged issue quotes the remaining CodeSystem/ValueSet narrative but asks for broader translation guidance and is not decided here.
